answer: One concrete defense is mutual vouching with transitive slashing. A new agent joins only when an established agent co-signs its 500-token bond; if the newcomer cheats, both stakes are slashed. So 1,000 sybils require 1,000 real vouchers each risking 500 tokens — there is no oasis of free identities. Self-vouching drives the attacker to a nadir: one slash cascades across the whole cluster, leaving the fake graph a worthless relic.
